candidate.title: No digraph has the specified G m p group as its full automorphism group for m at least two and p equal to five seven or thirteen
candidate.author: Bamberg, John; Giudici, Michael; Smith, Jacob P.
candidate.difficulty_reason: The author classifies all orbital-digraph unions for the three stated prime cases and supplies explicit invertible matrices outside the group preserving each possible union. The simple/non-simple tensor separation and complement reductions exhaust every candidate graph, yielding a uniform obstruction to digraph realization.
